import-board-instruction-issues: Paste a __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues become tarjetanaka grouped into jistʼaraña / Closed listanaka.
import-board-instruction-asana: Paste an Asana tasks anqäxar apayaña JSON ({ "data": [...] } ukata the Asana anqäxar apayaña jan ukax GET /tasks). Tasks apxi grouped into sections (memberships); tukuyata tasks go ukaru Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Paste a ZenKit lista anqäxar apayaña JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages become listanaka ukat items become tarjetanaka.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Markdown lurawi qillqata apantaña (Obsidian Kanban jina markdown-kanban lurañanaka apnaqaña): "## List sutipa" uñstayirinaka, "- [ ]"/"- [x]" jaqukiwinakampi manqhankiri. Uñstayirinaka listanakawa tukuyi, jaqukiwinakasti tarjetanakawa tukuyi; checkbox janiwa listasa tarjeta jistarata jani apayasa mantayasa.
import-board-instruction-leo: Leo wakichäwi (.leo qillqa imata) lip'iyañamawa. Altu patankir t'aqanakax sutinakaruw tukupxi, jupanakan chiqap aynachapankir t'aqanakax kartanakaruw tukupxi, t'aqan qillqapax kartan qhananchawipawa. Juk'amp manqhankir t'aqanakax uñakipaña sutinakaruw tukupxi. Chimput t'aqanakax tukuyatjamaw mantayasi.
import-board-instruction-opml: OPML qillqat qillqaqaña, kunjamatix Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ukat yaqha outliners ukanakax mistuyapki ukhama. Nayrïr thakhin yänakax listanakaruw tuku, wawanakapax tarjetanakaruw tuku qhanañchäwipamp chika, ukat juk'amp manqhan yänakax uñakipañ listanakaruw tuku. Tukuyata yänakax tukuyatjamaw apanitaski.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Org mode qillqat qillqaqaña, kunjamatix Emacs, Orgzly jan ukax Beorg qillqki ukhama. Nayrïr thakhin p'iqi sutinakax listanakaruw tuku, payïr thakhin p'iqi sutinakax tarjetanakaruw tuku. TODO ukat DONE, nayrïr lurañanaka, chimpunaka, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ukat CLOSED ukanakax imasiwa, ukat uñakipañ chimpunakas juk'amp manqhan p'iqi sutinakas uñakipañ listanakaruw tuku.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Mä todo.txt imata lip'iyam: sapa siqina mä luraña, todo.txt wakichäwi ukhamarak ukampi chikachasiñ atiri wakichäwinakax qillqapki ukhama. Tukuyata lurañanakax ("x") Tukuyata ukar sarapxi, +project ukat @context ukanakax chimpunakaruw tukupxi, (A) ukax nayrankañ chimpuw tuku, due: ukat t: ukanakax tukuyañ uru ukat qalltañ ururuw tukupxi.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: task export ukana mistutapa lip'katayaña: JSON siqi, jan ukaxa sapa siqina mä lurawi. Tukuyata lurawinakaxa Done ukaru sarapxi, project ukampi priority ukampixa unanchanakaru tukupxi, annotations ukaxa arxatanakaru tuku, depends ukaxa jark'iri lurawinakampi chint'atäñaru tuku.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: .boardarchive q'ipi jist'araña ukatxa pirqana board.jsonl ukapa lip'katayaña, versión siqimpi jan ukaxa jan uka siqinisa. Pirqa uñjäwina qutuchañataki kastapaxa suti siqinakaru tuku, yaqha ajlliña kastanakaxa unanchanakaru tukupxi, qillqata ukhamaraki chimpuña kajuna t'aqanakaxa qhananchawiru ukhamaraki uñakipaña sutinakaru tukupxi, arxatanakaxa imatäpxiwa. Uñacht'äwinakasa yapxatatanakasa janiwa apanitäkiti.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: MeisterTask ukan, proyecto sutip ch'iqt'aña, Export project ukat CSV mistuyaña, ukat qillqaqaña. Chiqanakax listanakaruw tuku, lurawinakax tarjetanakaruw tuku, qillqanakapamp, tukuyañ urupamp, lurayiripamp chimpunakapamp chika; tukuyata lurawinakax tukuyat urup imapxiwa. MeisterTask pachpa apaniñapatak qillqata CSV ukas wali askiwa.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Obsidian ukan, Kanban pirqa qillqatap Markdown ukham jist'araña (jan ukax .md qillqat mä qillqa askichirin jist'araña), ukat taqpach qillqaqaña. Thakhinakax listanakaruw tuku tarjeta límites ukanakapamp chika, tarjetanakax chimpunakap, urunakap, nayrïr lurañap, camponakap uñakipañ listap imapxiwa, ukat Archive ukax imata tarjetanakaruw tuku.
import-board-instruction-linear: Linear ukan, issues ukanak CSV ukham mistuyaña (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, jan ukax mä uñjañan mistuyäwipa), ukat CSV qillqaqaña. Estados ukanakax listanakaruw tuku, tamanakax thakhinakaruw tuku, issues ukanakax tarjetanakaruw tuku lurayiripamp, chimpunakapamp, urunakapamp, awki issue, nayrïr lurañap, estimate, proyecto ukat ciclo ukanakamp chika.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: TickTick ukan, Settings, Account, Backup & Import jist'araña ukat mä backup lurt'aña, ukat CSV qillqat qillqaqaña. Sapa TickTick listax mä thakhiruw tuku, columnanakapax listanakaruw tuku; lurawinakax chimpunakap, urunakap, uñakipañ listap, nayrïr lurañap ukat subtareas ukanak imapxiwa.
import-board-instruction-clickup: ClickUp ukan, lurawinak CSV ukham mistuyaña (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, jan ukax List jan ukax Table uñjañan mistuyäwipa taqi columnanakamp), ukat CSV qillqaqaña. Estados ukanakax listanakaruw tuku, ClickUp listanakax thakhinakaruw tuku, lurawinakax tarjetanakaruw tuku subtareas, lurayirinaka, chimpunaka, urunaka, nayrïr lurañ ukat pacha ukanakamp chika.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Nullboard ukan, pirqa jist'araña, menú ukan Export this board... ukar ajlliña, .nbx qillqat mä qillqa askichirin jist'araña ukat ukan utjki uk qillqaqaña. Listanakax listanakaruw tuku, notas ukanakax tarjetanakaruw tuku: mä nota nayrïr siqix tarjeta sutipawa, mayninakapax qhanañchäwipawa. Mä raw notax raw chimpu katuqi. Walja pirqanïr qillqatax nayrïr pirqapakiw apanitaski.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Kanri ukan, Import & Export jist'araña ukat Export individual board (jan ukax Export all data) ajlliña, ukat .json qillqat qillqaqaña. Columnanakax listanakaruw tuku, tarjetanakax tarjetanakaruw tuku qhanañchäwipamp, tukuyañ urupamp, chimpunakapamp samipamp chika; mä tarjetan lurawinakapax mä uñakipañ listaruw tuku. Taqi datos mistuyäwitxa nayrïr pirqaw apanitaski.
import-board-instruction-planka: Planka jach'a utjäwiman qillqt'am (amuyt'añataki https://planka.example.com), Planka apnaqirin sutimampi imantata arumampi, ukatsti Sutinaka uñacht'ayaña limt'am. Ukanakax pirqa apsuñatakikiw apnaqasi, janiw imatäkiti. Mä pirqa ajlliñamawa ukat Apsuña limt'am: WeKan ukax Planka API ukat liyi, sutinakapampi, kartanakapampi, qhananchawinakapampi, tukuyaña urunakapampi, unanchanakapampi, masinakapampi, irnaqawi sutinakapampi arxatanakapampi, ukatsti kunjamtix sapa kuti mantayañ sarantayam. Planka imañapan utjki uka kartanakax imatäkaspas ukham mantayatawa; chikachatanakampi q'añu wayaqan utjki uka kartanakampix janiw mantayatäkiti.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer) ukan mantam, Tasks.Read iyawsäwiru iyaw sam ukat token Access token ukat copiam. Akar ucham ukat Sutinaka uñacht'ayaña limt'am; tokenax aka apsuñatakikiw apnaqasi, janiw imatäkiti. Taqi sutinaka jan ukax maya ajlliñamawa ukat Apsuña limt'am. Sapa To Do sutinakax sutinakaruw tukuyi, sapa irnaqawis kartaruw tukuyi, qillqatanakapampi, tukuyaña qalltaña urunakapampi, thakhinakax uñakipaña sutinakjama, kasta qutunakax unanchanakjama, jach'a wakiskirimpi kunjamäñapampi unanchanakjama; tukuyat irnaqawinakax imañaruw apasi. Amtayawinakampi kutt'ayawinakampix janiw mantayatäkiti.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: KanbanFlow ukan pirqa menu jist'aram, Settings → API & Webhooks ajlliñamawa ukat pirqan API token copiam. Token akar ucham, Sutinaka uñacht'ayaña limt'am, pirqa ajlliñamawa ukat Apsuña limt'am; tokenax uka apsuñatakikiw apnaqasi, janiw imatäkiti. Sayt'unakax sutinakaruw tukuyi, thakhinakas thakhinakäskakiwa; irnaqawinakax qhananchawipa, saminakapa, unanchanakapa, tukuyaña urupa, jisk'a irnaqawinaka uñakipaña sutinakjama, apnaqat pacha, amuyt'awi, jaqinaka arxatanakapampi imapxi.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Basecamp cuentaman ID qillqt'am (jach'a utjäwin basecamp.com/ qhipäxan utjki uka jakhu) ukat mä mantaña token (launchpad.37signals.com ukan qillqantat OAuth 2 app ukat, jan ukax mä utjkir integración ukan utjxi ukat), Sutinaka uñacht'ayaña limt'am, mä proyecto ajlliñamawa ukat Apsuña limt'am. Tokenax uka apsuñatakikiw apnaqasi, janiw imatäkiti. Sapa kartanakan tablapax thakhiruw tukuyi sayt'unakapax sutinakjama, lurañanakan sutinakapas To-dos thakhiruw tukuyi; kartanakampi lurañanakampix qillqatapa, urunakapa, katuyat jaqinaka arxatanakapampi imapxi, kartan thakhinakapax uñakipaña sutinakaruw tukuyi, tukuyat lurañanakas imañaruw apasi.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: OAuth 2.0 Playground ukat mä mantaña token katuqam: Tasks API v1 manqhan tasks.readonly ajlliñamawa, Authorize APIs limt'am, ukat Exchange authorization code for tokens, ukat mantaña token copiam. Akar ucham ukat Sutinaka uñacht'ayaña limt'am, taqi irnaqawi sutinaka jan ukax maya ajlliñamawa, ukat Apsuña. Tokenax aka apsuñatakikiw apnaqasi, janiw imatäkiti. Irnaqawi sutinakax sutinakaruw tukuyi irnaqawinakas kartanakaruw tukuyi, qillqatanakapampi, chikachawinakapampi tukuyaña urupampi; jisk'a irnaqawinakax uñakipaña sutinakaruw tukuyi tukuyat irnaqawinakas imatäkaspas ukham mantayatawa.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: Google Keep API ukax Google Workspace cuentanakatakikiwa. https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly alcance ukamp mä OAuth 2.0 mantaña token katuqam (OAuth 2.0 Playground ukan Workspace apnaqiriman iyaw sapxi ukaxa, jan ukax taqi dominio ukar apnaqir servicio cuenta ukat), ucham, Sutinaka uñacht'ayaña limt'am ukat Apsuña. Tokenax aka apsuñatakikiw apnaqasi, janiw imatäkiti. Qillqat amtanakax Amtanaka sutinakan kartanakaruw tukuyi, uñakipaña amtanakas Sutinaka sutinakan kartanakaruw tukuyi yänakapax uñakipaña sutinakjama. Q'añu wayaqan amtanaka, chikachatanaka ukat churasiñax janiw mantayatäkiti.
api-import-desc: Servicio ukat juma pachpa cuentamamp apsum. Akan qillqt'kta ukax aka apsuñatakikiw apnaqasi, janiw imatäkiti.
api-import-fetched: Apsutawa. Aynacht'an masinak uñakipam ukat mantayam.
api-import-nothing: Aka cuentampix janiw kunas mantayañatak utjkiti.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Pivotal Tracker ukan, proyecto MORE pestaña jist'araña ukat Export CSV ajlliña (jan ukax sarnaqäwinak ajlliña ukat Bulk Actions, CSV ajlliña), ukat CSV qillqaqaña. Sapa sarnaqäwi estado mä listaruw tuku, sarnaqäwinakax tarjetanakaruw tuku kastapamp, chimpunakapamp, dueños, mayiri, urunaka, amuyt'awinaka, lurawinaka ukat blockers ukanakamp chika; Estimate ukax Story points ukaruw tuku, iteraciones ukanakax sprints ukanakaruw tuku.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Tasks.org ukan, Settings, Backups jist'araña ukat Export tasks ajlliña, ukat uka .json qillqatan utjki uk qillqaqaña. Listanakax listanakaruw tuku, lurawinakax tarjetanakaruw tuku qillqanakapamp, chimpunakapamp, urunakapamp, amuyt'awinakapamp subtareas ukanakamp chika; tukuyata lurawinakax tukuyat urup imapxiwa, nayrïr lurañax mä pachpa campo ukaruw tuku.
import-board-instruction-monday: monday.com ukan, pirqa menú jist'araña, More actions ukat Export board to Excel ajlliña (munstaxa updates ukat subitems ukanakamp chika), ukat uka .xlsx qillqat ajlliña. Status columnax listanakaruw tuku, tamanakax thakhinakaruw tuku; jaqinaka, urunaka, timeline ukat chimpunakax chiqapan qhiparapxi, yaqha columnanakax pachpa camponakaruw tuku, updates ukanakax amuyt'awinakaruw tuku.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Super Productivity ukan, Settings jist'araña, ukat Sync & Backup, Export Data ajlliña ukat sp-backup .json qillqatan utjki uk qillqaqaña. Sapa proyectox mä thakhiruw tuku, lurawinakax To Do, In Progress, Backlog jan ukax Done ukan tarjetanakaruw tuku, qillqanakapamp, chimpunakapamp, tukuyañ urupamp, apnaqat pachapamp sub-tasks ukanakamp chika; imata lurawinakax imata tarjetanakaruw tuku.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Taiga ukan, Admin > Project > Export jist'araña ukat proyecto dump apaqaña (nayraqat .json.gz qillqat jist'araña), ukat JSON qillqaqaña. User story estados ukanakax listanakaruw tuku, user stories ukanakax tarjetanakaruw tuku lurawinakapax subtareas ukhama, epics ukat issues ukanakax pachpa thakhinakanïpxiwa, sprints, chimpunaka, amuyt'awinaka ukat pachpa atributos ukanakas jutapxiwa. Chikachatanakax janiw apanitäkiti.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Vikunja ukan, Settings jist'araña, Data Export ajlliña ukat apayanktam uka .zip qillqat apaqaña, ukat uka qillqat ajlliña, jan ukax manqhapan data.json qillqaqaña. Kanban buckets ukanakax listanakaruw tuku, lurawinakax tarjetanakaruw tuku chimpunakapamp, lurayirinakapamp, urunakapamp, qhanañchäwipamp, lurawi listanakax uñakipañ listanakjama amuyt'awinakapamp chika; nayrïr lurañ, porcentaje tukuyata ukat tukuyatax pachpa camponakaruw tuku. Chikachatanakax janiw apanitäkiti.
import-board-instruction-quire: Quire ukan, proyecto menú jist'araña ukat Export CSV ajlliña, ukat CSV qillqaqaña. Estados ukanakax listanakaruw tuku, lurawinakax tarjetanakaruw tuku subtareas wawa tarjetanakjama, lurayirinaka, chimpunakax chimpunakjama, qallta, tukuyañ ukat tukuyata urunaka, qhanañchäwi ukat nayrïr lurañax pachpa campo ukhama. Amuyt'awinakas chikachatanakas janiw Quire CSV ukan utjkiti.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Wrike ukan, mä proyecto jan ukax carpeta Excel ukar mistuyaña, jan ukax Wrike Excel apaniñ uñacht'äwi phuqhaña, ukat uka .xlsx qillqat ajlliña. Carpeta ukat proyecto siqinakax thakhinakaruw tuku, Status ukax listanakaruw tuku, lurawinakax tarjetanakaruw tuku Key, awki lurawi, lurayirinaka, qallta ukat tukuyañ urunaka, dependencias ukat qhanañchäwipamp chika; Priority, Duration ukat yaqha columnanakax pachpa camponakaruw tuku.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Teamwork.com ukan, Excel lurawi apaniñ uñacht'äwi phuqhaña (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ukat .xlsx ukham imaña, ukat uka qillqat ajlliña. Lurawi listanakax listanakaruw tuku, lurawinakax tarjetanakaruw tuku; -, # jan ukax > ukamp qallti uka lurawix patapan lurawin subtarea ukaruw tuku (--, ## jan ukax >> mä thakhi juk'amp manqhana). Lurayirinaka, urunaka ukat chimpunakax chiqapan qhiparapxi; Priority, Estimated time ukat Complete ukanakax pachpa camponakaruw tuku.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Businessmap (nayrax Kanbanize) ukan, Advanced Search jist'araña, Configure results ajlliña columnanak ajllinkañataki, Excel qillqat apaqaña, ukat uka .xlsx qillqat ajlliña. Columnanakax inglés sutinakapampiw liyitaski (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): cuentamax yaqha arun utji ukhax nayraqat p'iqi siqi inglés aruru suti mayjt'ayaña. Column ukax listanakaruw tuku, Lane ukax thakhinakaruw tuku; dueños, chimpunaka, sami, urunaka, amuyt'awinaka ukat awki chinunakax chiqapan qhiparapxi, Priority, Size, Type ukat yaqha columnanakax pachpa camponakaruw tuku.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Redmine ukan, proyecto Issues jist'araña, listan aynacht'ap Also available in: CSV ajlliña, columnanak ajlliña (All columns, Description ukamp chika) ukat mistuyaña, ukat CSV qillqaqaña. Redmine ukax columnanak arumaruw sutichi, ukhamax mistuyañat nayraqat My account ukan arum inglés aruru uchaña. Sapa estado mä listaruw tuku, issues ukanakax tarjetanakaruw tuku, tracker chimpujama, lurayiri, qillqiri, urunaka, awki lurawi ukat chikt'ata issues ukanakamp chika; nayrïr lurañ, categoría, target version, estimated time, % Done ukat pachpa camponakax pachpa camponakaruw tuku.
import-board-instruction-notion: Notion ukan, base de datos taqpach pankjama jist'araña, ••• ukat Export ajlliña, Markdown & CSV ajlliña, ukat apaqki uka .zip qillqat ajlliña, jan ukax ukat mä base de datos CSV, jan ukax uka CSV qillqaqaña. Status sutini columnax listanakaruw tuku (jan utjki ukhax, select ukar uñtasit nayrïr columnaw tuku, apaniñ yatiyäwix kawkïris sasaw qhanañchi); siqinakax tarjetanakaruw tuku sutipamp, chimpunakapamp, jaqinakax masinakjama, urunaka, panka qillqax qhanañchäwjama; yaqha columnanakax pachpa camponakaruw tuku. Relaciones, uñnaqanaka ukat chikachatanakax janiw apanitäkiti.
import-board-instruction-plane: Plane ukan, Workspace Settings jist'araña, Exports ajlliña, proyectonak JSON, CSV jan ukax Excel ukham mistuyaña ukat .zip qillqat apaqaña, ukat uka qillqat ajlliña, jan ukax manqhapan mä qillqat, jan ukax JSON jan ukax CSV qillqaqaña. Estados ukanakax listanakaruw tuku, proyectonakax thakhinakaruw tuku, issues ukanakax tarjetanakaruw tuku identificador, awki, lurayirinaka, chimpunaka, urunaka, chinunaka ukat amuyt'awinakapamp chika; nayrïr lurañ, estimate, ciclo ukat módulo ukanakax pachpa camponakaruw tuku. Plane mistuyäwipanx janiw qhanañchäwinakas chikachatanakas utjkiti, ukhamax janiw apanitäkiti.
import-board-instruction-trello: mana your Trello pirqa, go ukaru 'Menu', then 'More', 'Print ukat Export', 'anqäxar apayaña JSON', ukat qillqaqaña the resulting qillqa.
import-board-instruction-csv: Paste mana your Comma Separated Values(CSV)/ Tab Separated Values (TSV) .
import-board-instruction-jira: Paste the JSON ukata the Jira Cloud REST API issue thaqaña (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), jan ukax an equivalent { "issues": [...] } object. Jira statuses become listanaka ukat issues become tarjetanaka. Optionally include an "automationRules" array ukaru anqäxat apaniña rules.
import-board-instruction-excel: ajlliña a WeKan-style .xlsx spreadsheet (the same columns as the Excel anqäxar apayaña: pʼiqiñcha, qhanañchäwi, kunjamasa/lista, miembros, Labels, dates, custom fields). The first row awa the header.
import-board-instruction-wekan: mana your pirqa, go ukaru 'Menu', then 'anqäxar apayaña board', ukat qillqaqaña the qillqa mana the downloaded qillqa-wayaqa.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: If you get errors when importing pirqa, sometimes importing still works, ukat pirqa awa ukana taqi pirqanaka page.
import-without-mapping-members: anqäxat apaniña jani mapping miembros (map later)
import-members-mode-map: Sapa mayniru mä utjki uka apnaqiri ajlliña
import-members-mode-placeholder: Pachpa sutinakapamp sustituto apnaqirinakjama imaña, qhipat chiqpach apnaqirinakar chikt'añataki
csv-mapping-description: Sapa tarjeta campo katxaruki uka qillqatan columna ajlliña. Ajllitanakax columna sutinakat luratawa; kawkïrinakatix pantjata ukanak mayjt'ayaña, ukat qillqatan jan utjki uka campotakix (not in the file) ajlliña.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Qillqatan janiw lista columnas utjkiti. Patan mayni ajlliña, jan ukax taqi tarjetanakax mantki uka mä lista sutip qillqaña.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Yaqha columnanaka, qillqa pachpa camponakjama apaniñataki:
csv-mapping-title-required: Tarjeta sutinak katxaruki uka columna ajlliña.
csv-mapping-list-required: Taqi tarjetanakax mantki uka lista sutip qillqaña, jan ukax lista katxaruki uka columna ajlliña.
import-many-boards-hint: Aka yänakan walja mistuyat qillqatanak ajlliña, jan ukax ukanak katxaruki uka mä .zip: sapa qillqatax pachpa pirqaparuw tuku, jan masinak chikt'asa apanita. Pachpa mä mistuyäwïki uka .zip (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, jan ukax WeKan chikachatanakamp) mä pirqakiwa. Akan qillqatanak ajllitäki ukhax, Import ukax patan campo lantix ukanakaw apani.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Apaniñax luraspa uka sapa thakhi (mä proyecto, carpeta jan ukax yänakan listapa) pachpa pirqaparuw tuku. Uka pirqanak taypin awki tarjetanakas dependencias ukanakas apaniñ yatiyäwin qillqatawa.
export-all-boards-hint: Mistuyirjam taqi pirqanaka, mä apaqäwina: Excel mä libro ukhama sapa pirqatak sutipampi mä hoja, yaqha formatonakax mä .zip ukhama sapa pirqatak mä qillqatampi.
import-json-placeholder: Aymar aruna: Paste your valid JSON data here
import-csv-placeholder: Aymar aruna: Paste your valid CSV/TSV data here
import-json-file: jan ukax ajlliña a Trello JSON qillqa-wayaqa

globalSearch-instructions-description: Searches can include operators ukaru refine the thaqaña.  Operators apxi specified by writing the operator suti ukat value separated by a colon.  For example, an operator specification -na `list:Blocked` would limit the thaqaña ukaru tarjetanaka uka apxi contained mana a lista named *Blocked*.  If the value contains spaces jan ukax special characters it must be enclosed mana quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).

Placing a `-` mana front -na *<field>* searches for the absence -na a value mana uka field (e.g. `has:-due` searches for tarjetanaka jani a tukuyañ uru).

scrum-edit-sprint: Amtat sprint lurt'aña jan ukax askichaña
scrum-releases-select-help: Mä tarjetax walja mistuwinakan utjaspawa. Maya sipan juk'amp ajlliñatakix Ctrl (Mac ukan Cmd) katxaruña; taqi mistuwinakat tarjeta apaqañatakix taqpach q'umachaña.

scrum-no-closed-sprints: Janiw kuna jist'antat sprint uñnaqas utjkiti.
scrum-report-help: Yatiyäwinakax sprint uñnaqanakat jakhuwinak imapxi. Jan uñt'at jakhuwinakax sapakiw jakhutaski; janiw ch'usa jakhuwinakäkiti. Jank'akiñax kikip jakhuñ tupunakampi kamachinakampikiw chikachasispa.
scrum-confirm-close: Aka sprint jist'antañati ukat achuwinakap imañati? Jan tukuyat tarjetanakax ajllit chiqaruw sarapxani.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Aka sprint jaytañati? Tarjetanakapax wasitat churatäñkamaw ukankapxani.
scrum-partial-report: Mä t'aqa yatiyäwi: jichhax jumar churat tarjetanakakiw uchantatäski.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Aka sprintax nayrïr uñnaqan mä t'aqapakiw utji.
scrum-rollover-progress: Jisk’a pacha irnaqawina kartanakapa nayraru apnaqaña: __total__ taypita __done__
scrum-history-job-running: Jach’a mayjt’awi qhiparu kutt’ayaña jan ukaxa mayampi luraña: nayra sarawina __total__ siq’inakapat __done__
scrum-history-job-failed: Jach’a mayjt’awi qhiparu kutt’ayaña jan ukaxa mayampi luraña sayt’awayi. Sarantaskakiñataki qhiparu kutt’ayaña jan ukaxa mayampi luraña limt’aña mayampi limt’ma:
scrum-daily-observations: Sapüru lurawi ukat qhiparki uka lurawi (uñjawinaka)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Sapa barrax mä UTC urun nayrïr qillqat uñjawip uñacht'ayi, uñacht'at pachana. Jan utjki uka urunakax jaytatawa. Aka uñjawinakax janiw taqi mayjt'awinak qillqapkiti ni uru tukuyan taqpach jakhunak uñacht'ayapkiti. Jan uñt'at jakhuwinakax janiw ch'usäkiti. Sapüru uñjawinakatakix aka t'aqan Export lurawip apnaqaña; barra Export lurawix sprint achuwinak mistuyi.
scrum-daily-empty: Aka sprintatakix janiw kuna sapüru uñjawinakas qillqatäkiti.
scrum-scope-history: Lurawi taqpacha ukat jilt'ir lurawi, sapa mayjt'awi qhipat
scrum-scope-history-help: Sprint qalltatpacha pirqan Nayra sarawipat wasitat lurata: sprint kartanakana, tantiyawinakana jan ukax tukuyat lurawina sapa mayjt'awitakix mä siqi.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Nayra sarawix janiw aka sprintan imat uñjawip wasitat lurkiti: yaqhip mayjt'awinakax Nayra sarawiru jan qillqat luratapxiwa, ukatwa aka jakhunakax jan phuqhatapkiti.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Nayrïr mayjt'awinakakiw ullasiñ atitäna; wasitat luratax janiw phuqhatäkiti.
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Kartax imañ utan imata jan ukax kutt'ayatawa
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Sapa UTC urun nayrïr qillqat uñjawipa; jan utjki uka urunakax jaytatawa. Uñjawinakax janiw taqi mayjt'awinak ni uru tukuyan taqpach jakhunak qillqapkiti. Jan uñt'at jakhuwinakax janiw ch'usäkiti.

scrum-import-recovery-hint: Wasitat qalltañampi sayt'ayat mantayawix akan tukuyasiñjamawa, sayt'atapat qhipa. Amtapax jan phuqhat imatäkchi ukhax jaytañakiw lurasispa; ukax janiw pirqana kuns mayjt'aykiti.
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Mä WeKan pirqa mistuyäwi jan ukax Scrum apayañ qillqat ajlliña. Aka pirqan utjki uka sprints ukat mistuwinakax chinuntatawa, janiw pä kuti luratäkiti. Tarjetanakax ID ukampi, jan ukax tarjeta jakhumpi sutimpi kikipt'ayatawa; jan kikipki uka tarjetanakax qillqatawa ukat jan mayjt'ayatäkiwa. Kunas mayjt'ani uk uñjañatakix nayraqat uñakipaña.
scrum-import-invalid-file: Aka qillqatax janiw wali JSON ukäkiti.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprintnaka: __created__ machaqa, __matched__ niya aka pirqana, __skipped__ jan apanita
scrum-import-preview-releases: Mistuwinaka: __created__ machaqa, __matched__ niya aka pirqana, __skipped__ jan apanita
scrum-import-preview-cards: Tarjetanaka: __updated__ machaqtayañataki, __unchanged__ jan mayjt'ata, __unmatched__ jan kikipt'ata
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Janiw kunas mayjt'ayañax utjkiti: aka pirqax niyaw aka wakicht'awinïxi.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Scrum wakicht'awix apanitawa ukat Sarnaqäwin qillqatawa.
scrum-import-card-not-matched: Mä tarjetax janiw aka pirqan jikxataskiti: __reference__
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Mä tarjetax aka pirqan maya sipan juk'amp tarjetanakampiw kikipt'i: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Mä tarjetax yaqha pirqankiwa ukat jan mayjt'ayatäkiwa: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Mä sprint jan ukax mistuwix aka pirqan maya sipan juk'ampimpiw kikipt'i: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Mä sprint, mistuwi jan ukax jach'a urux janiw apanitäkaspati: __reference__
scrum-import-sprint-finished: Mä tarjetax janiw tukuyat sprint ukar unxtayatäkiti: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Sapa ch'axwawitak mä chani ajlliña. Sync ukax sapa ajlliwitxa wasitat yant'i. Janiw kunas jutäw sistemaru apayatäkiti.
sync-conflict-refresh: Jichha chaninak uñakipañatakix Sync wasitat sarantayaña.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Jumar churat tarjetanakax uñakipatawa. Janiw kuna campo ch'axwawinakas qhiparkiti. Taqpach lista Sync ukax janiw sarantayatäkiti.
sync-conflict-detach: Pä kutin tarjeta aka chiqan tarjetjam imaña
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Aka pä kutin tarjetan Sync chikt'awipakiw apaqaña. Manqhapax WeKan ukankaskakiniwa.
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Jutäw yäx chhaqtxiwa, ukampis sarantir subtarjetanakax imañ jark'apxi. Sync chikt'awip apaqasa aka tarjeta aka chiqan imaña. Subtarjetanakax janiw mayjt'ayatäkiti.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Nayrïr tarjeta jan mayjt'ayasa imaña ukat aka listan mä machaq Sync tarjeta lurt'aña. Wasitat yant'awinakax turkañ tarjetaw apnaqapxi.
sync-preview-saved: Imat wakichäwinakat luratawa. Sync now ukax jutäw wasitat apani ukat uñakipi.
sync-preview-unavailable: Nayraqat uñjañ mayiñat nayraqat mä Sync jutäw imaña.
sync-preview-blocked: Mayjt'añ amta uñakipañat nayraqat aka manqhan ch'axwawinak askichaña.
sync-preview-scope: Jakhunakax normalizat jutäw camponakatwa parli. Jutäw parser ukax yaqha datos jaytaspawa.
sync-source-scope: Thakhinakax jutäw yänakan campo uñstäwinakap tantachapxi. Jan chikt'at yänakax taqpachaw yatiyatäski; chaninakapax janiw uñacht'ayatäkiti.
sync-source-converted: Qillqaru jan ukax yaqha uñacht'äwir tukuyata
sync-source-fallback: Parser ukan jan apnaqat yaqha chani
sync-source-occurrences: Yatiyat campo jan ukax yä uñstäwinaka
sync-source-truncated: Yatiyäwix 100 thakhinakaru ukat jisk'achat campo sutinakaruw jark'ata.
sync-report-partial: Pantjat jan ukax jan tukuyat sarantawinakax yaqhip tarjetanak mayjt'ayapxaspawa. Aka yatiyäwinakax janiw mä sarantaw wasitat sarantayapkiti ni jan luratäkaspas ukham lurapkiti.
sync-report-unfinished: Sarantaski jan ukax sayt'ayata; achuwix jan qillqata
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Jaytat jan ukax tukuyat camponakamp tukuyata
sync-report-unavailable: Sarantaw yatiyäwinakax taqpach lista qillqañ mantañ ukat utjir servidor wakisi.
sync-report-empty: Janiw kuna qillqat Sync sarantawinakas utjkiti.
sync-recovery-description: Qhipïr 30 urunakan imat Sync yatiyäwinaka. Pirqa jan ukax lista ID ukamp thaqhaña. Jan tukuyat achuwix sarantaskaspawa jan ukax sayt'ayatäspawa. Wasitat uñakipañatakix machaqtayaña; aka yatiyäwinakax janiw mayjt'awinak wasitat sarantayapkaspati ni jan luratäkaspas ukham lurapkaspati.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Janiw Sync uñakipawinak liyiskaspati. Apnaqir mantañ ukat servidor utjatap uñakipaña.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Jira campo ID ukat jakhuñ tupuni mä jakhu campo ajlliña, chikt'at Jira apaniwimp lurataki ukhama. Aka chiqan mayjt'awinakax ch'axwawinakjamaw uñakipatäski. Jan utjir jutäw chaninakax jaytatawa; qhanañchat null ukax chikt'at chani q'umachi.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: GitLab jathitapa jan ukax pacha tantiyawipax ajllitam jakhu chiqar qillqatawa. Akan lurat mayjt'awinakax jan walt'awinakjam uñakipatawa; jathitap jan utjki uka jan walt'awix chint'at jakhuru chhaqtayi.
email-recovery-description: Sapa katuqiritakixa mä siqi. Apnaqirin ID ukamp thaqam. Yatiyäwinakan utjirinakapa ukhamarak katuqirin elektroniku yatiyäwi chiqanakapaxa janiw uñacht'ayatäkiti. Mä juk'a sayt'ayañaxa jichha utjir ukhamarak jutïr yatiyäwinak suyt'ayi; sarantayañaxa siqinkir yatiyäwinak jichhax mayamp apayañ yant'i. Jaytañaxa mayiwi urasapkama siqiru uchata yatiyäwinak chhaqtayi. Apayañax saraskchi ukhaxa, mä juk'a pacha qhipat mayamp yant'am. Apayañ qalltat yatiyäwixa janiw kutt'ayaskaspati, ukat puritapax jan yatiskchi uka yatiyäwixa mayamp apayataspawa. Wiñay pantjasïwinaka ukhamarak yant'añ jakhuw jan mayamp jilxatañapatak utt'ayata tukuyir purir yatiyäwinakaxa uñakipañatak imatawa. Jan phuqhasir yatiyäwinak mayamp yant'añaxa machaq yant'äwinak qallti ukat utjki uka mä juk'a sayt'ayäwi imaraki.
email-recovery-empty: Janiw siqinkir yatiyäwinakas utjkiti, janirakiw apayañ mä juk'a sayt'ayata katuqirinakas utjkiti.
email-recovery-unavailable: Elektroniku yatiyäwi siqi janiw ullañjamäkiti. Irpirin mantañ kamachinakap ukhamarak servidor apnaqañjamätap uñakipam.
email-recovery-busy: Apayañasa jan ukax siqina yaqha lurañasa saraskiwa. Machaqacham ukat mä juk'a pacha qhipat mayamp yant'am.
email-recovery-failed: Luräwi janiw chiqpachapunïtap uñacht'ayasiñjamäkänti. Siqi machaqacham ukat wakischi ukhaxa uka pachpa luräwi mayamp yant'am.
email-recovery-superseded: Luririn machaq luräwipaxa aka mayiwi lantiwa. Siqin jichha kunjamätap uñacht'ayaskiwa.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Aka katuqiritaki jichha siqinkir taqpach yatiyäwinak jaytañ munta? Utjirinakapax chhaqtayatäniwa ukat janiw kutt'ayasiñjamäkaniti. Aka mayiwi qhipat lurat machaq yatiyäwinakaxa imatäniwa.
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Katuqirix janiw utjkiti jan ukax cuentax jan ch'amanchatawa
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Apayawix janiw chiqanchaskaspati; wasitat yant'añat nayraqat uñakipaña
sync-time-estimate-hint: Pacha jakhuwinakax Jira apaniwimp lurat nayrïr/qhiparki uka pacha jakhu camponak apnaqapxi. Aka pirqan mä kikipt'ir campokiw utjañapa. Aka chiqan askichawinakax ch'axwawinakjamaw uñakipatäski; jan utjir jutäw chaninakax jaytatawa ukat qhanañchat null ukax chani q'umachi.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint ukat mistuwinakax aka pirqan Scrum ch'amanchatäki ukhakiw chikancht'atäski. Jan utjki uka sprint jan ukax mistuwix aka pirqan luratawa, jutäw churki uka urunakampi; utjki ukax nayraqat jutäw ID ukampi, ukat sutimpiw kikipt'ayata. Aka chiqan wakicht'aw mayjt'awix jutäwix uka issue wakicht'awip mayjt'ayañkamaw qhipari, ukat nayrïr Sync ukax janipuniw wakicht'aw apaqkiti.
activity-recovery-description: Jan tukuyat yatiyäwinakax pachpaw wasitat yant'atäski. Wasitat yant'añat nayraqat jan utjir jan ukax mayjt'at luräwinak uñakipaña. Wasitat yant'añax janipuniw mä luräwi wasitat lurkiti.
activity-recovery-empty: Janiw kuna suyt'ir luräwi yatiyäwinakas utjkiti.
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Amta ukat suyt'ir luräwix janiw kikipkiti
activity-recovery-busy: Yaqha irnaqiriw aka yatiyäwi apnaqaski. Machaqtayaña ukat wasitat yant'aña.
activity-recovery-denied: Katuqir mantaña jan ukax yatiyäw munañanakax janiw apayañ jaysxiti.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Nayrïr luräwix janiw utjkiti jan ukax mayjt'atawa. Janiw kunas wasitat luratäkiti.
activity-recovery-failed: Janiw yatiyäw apayaw tukuyaskaspati. Suyt'ir lurawix imatawa.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Aka yatiyäwix apatat jilaw mayjt'i. Wasitat yant'añat nayraqat machaqtayat estado uñakipaña.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Janiw apayañ wakichäwi chiqanchaskaspati. Machaqtayaña ukat jichha estadop uñakipaña.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Aka luräwitak qhiparki uka apayaw wiñayatak jaytañati? Ukax janiw wasitat sarantayaskaspati. Niya fila ukan email ukat apayat yatiyäwinakax janiw kutt'ayatäkiti.
rule-email-recovery-description: Kamachinakan imayl apayañ yant'äwinak qillqatäki ukanak uñakipam. Janïr chiqanchat yant'äwinakax apayaskakispawa jan ukax chika thakhin sayt'ayatäspawa. Aka yatiyäwix janiw mayamps apaykiti, janirakiw apayañ sayt'aykiti.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Aka thaqhäwirjam kamachinakan imayl apayañ yant'äwix janiw utjkiti.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Janiw kamachi email yant'awinak apaskaspati. Wasitat yant'añatakix machaqtayaña.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan janïr chiqanchata imayl jupa pachpat janiw mayamps apaykiti. Mayampi apayañax janïr chiqanchata katuqirinakarukiw sari. Puritap yatsta ukhaxa apayata sasaw chimpum, jan ukax apayaña sayt'ayam.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Nayrïr apayañax inas saraskchi. __time__ qhipat amtañamawa.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Aka imayl janïr chiqanchata katuqirinakar mayampi apayañ muntati? Khitin imayl sirwiripax WeKan ukar jan yatiyas katuqki ukax pä kutiw katuqani.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Aka imayl taqinir apayata sas chimpuñ muntati? Puritap yatkasaki ukham luram.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Aka imayl apayaña sayt'ayañ muntati? Janïr chiqanchata katuqirinakar janiw apayaskaniti.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Nayrïr apayañax inas saraskchi. Qhipat mayampi yant'am.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Nayra mayampi apayañax inas saraskchi. Qhipat mayampi yant'am.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Taqpach katuqirinakax chiqanchatäxiwa. Ukhamax apayata sasaw chimpum.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Imayl sirwirix janiw jayskiti. Mayampi apayata imaylax inas purinchispa, jan ukax jan purkchispa; saraski sasaw uñachayasi.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Yaqha apnaqiriw aka imayl askichaski. Mä juk'a pachañ qhipat mayampi yant'am.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imata imaylax aka yant'äwimp janiw chikachasxiti, ukatwa akan jan askichañjamäkiti.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Aka yant'äwin imata qillqatapax janiw walïkiti, ukatwa akan jan askichañjamäkiti.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Aka imayl janiw askichañjamäkiti. Laphi mayampi jist'aram ukat mayampi yant'am.
rule-email-legacy-description: Aka kamachi imaylanakax mä nayra WeKan uñjawin wakichatawa, ukax manqhan utjki ukax kawkhats juti uk janiw qillqkataynati, ukatwa WeKan jupa pachpat jan apaykaniti. Nayraqat kamachi luririx mantañ iyawsäwinïskiti uk uñakipam, ukat imayl mayampi chinthapim jichha kartarjam mayampi wakichañataki, jan ukax jaqum.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Aka imayl jichha kartarjam mayampi wakichañ muntati? Manqhan utjki ukax nayra wakichat sipan mayjäspawa.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Aka imayl jaquñ muntati? Janipuniw apayaskaniti.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Janiw uñakipäwi suyasiri kamachi imaylanakax utjkiti.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Uñakipäwi suyasiri kamachi imaylanakax janiw apaniñjamäkiti. Laphi mayampi jist'aram mayampi yant'añataki.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Kamachi luririx aka kartar mantañ iyawsäwin janiw utjxiti jan ukaxa kamachix mayjt'xiwa, ukatwa imayl jan mayampi chinthapiñjamäkiti. Jaquñamawa.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Aka imayl qalltayiri lurawix mayjt'xiwa, ukatwa jan mayampi chinthapiñjamäkiti. Jaquñamawa.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Aka imaylax jutki uka kartax janiw utjxiti, ukatwa jan mayampi chinthapiñjamäkiti. Jaquñamawa.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Aka imayl wakichiri kamachi phuqhäwix janiw imatäxiti, ukatwa jan mayampi chinthapiñjamäkiti. Jaquñamawa.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Aka imaylax apayatäxiwa, apayañ yant'atäxiwa jan ukax jaqutäxiwa.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Aka lurawi janiw tukuyañjamäkiti. Laphi mayampi jist'aram ukat mayampi yant'am.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Wasitat jan sarantayaskaspa uka List Sync lurawinaka
stuck-sync-operation-description: Aka imat List Sync lurawinakax taypinkiw sayt'apxi ukat janiw tukuyaskxaspati, listapax apaqatäkänwa, wasitat luratäkänwa jan ukax wasitat wakicht'atäkänwa, jan ukax qalltayir apnaqirix qillqañ mantañ chhaqtayi. Mayax suyt'kani ukhakamax uka listax janiw Sync luraskaspati. Lista wasitat Sync lurañapatakix jaytaña: niya apnaqat mayjt'awinakax qhiparapxiwa, qhiparki uka imat mayjt'awinakax janipuniw qillqatäkiti, ukat jutir Sync ukax listamp jutäwimp wasitat chikachi.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Listax apaqatawa, wasitat luratawa jan ukax Sync wakichäwinakapax mayjt'atawa
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Qalltayir apnaqirix janiw taqpach listar qillqañ mantañanïxiti
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Nayrïr WeKan versiónampiw imata, kunas qalltayi uk jan qillqasa
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Khitis qalltayi uka qillqax janiw utjkiti
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Jichhax wasitat sarantayaspawa ukat pachpaw tukuyani, ukhamax janiw jaytaskaspati.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Aka imat List Sync lurawi jaytañati? Niya apnaqat mayjt'awinakax qhiparapxiwa; mayninakax janipuniw qillqatäkiti. Ukatsti listax wasitat Sync luraspawa.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Janiw kuna List Sync lurawinakas uñakipañ suyt'kiti.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Nayrïr 50 ukanakakiw uñacht'ayatäski. Juk'amp uñjañatakix yaqhipanak jaytaña ukat machaqtayaña.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Janiw List Sync lurawinak apaskaspati. Wasitat yant'añatakix machaqtayaña.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Aka lurawix janiw sayt'atäkaspas ukham jikxataskiti, ukhamax janiw jaytaskaspati.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Aka lurawix jichhax wasitat sarantayaspawa ukat pachpaw tukuyani, ukhamax janiw jaytatäkiti.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Aka listax jichhaw chikancht'aski. Mä juk'at wasitat yant'aña.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Aka lurawi janiw tukuyañjamäkiti. Laphi mayampi jist'aram ukat mayampi yant'am.
interrupted-import-description: Aka pirqa apaniwinakax taypinkiw sayt'apxi - servidorax wasitat qalltawayi, jan ukax apaniwix pantjawayi - ukat mä t'aqa pirqa jaytawayi. Mä apaniwix janiw sarantayaskaspati, jutäw qillqatapax jan imatätap layku. Pirqa kunjamäki ukham imaña, jan ukax jaytaña ukat qillqat wasitat apaniña. Jaytañax aka apaniw lurat pirqa ukat taqi ukankki uk apaqi, ukat jilat yapxatat taqikunas.
interrupted-import-scrum: Scrum t'aqapax pachpa checkpoint ukaniwa (__state__, __next__ / __total__ kayunaka). Pirqa imañ munstaxa, pirqan Scrum apaniw kutt'ayañat tukuyaña jan ukax jaytaña.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ thakhinaka, __lists__ listanaka, __cards__ tarjetanaka, __checklists__ uñakipañ listanaka, __comments__ amuyt'awinaka, __attachments__ chikachatanaka
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Aka t'aqa pirqa kunjamäki ukham imañati? Janiw kunas apaqatäkiti, ukat apaniwix janiw akan qillqatäxiti.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Aka apaniw jaytañati? Lurat pirqa ukat taqi ukankki ukax wiñayatakiw apaqatäni.
interrupted-import-empty: Janiw kuna sayt'at pirqa apaniwinakas uñakipañ suyt'kiti.
interrupted-import-truncated: Nayrïr 50 ukanakakiw uñacht'ayatäski. Juk'amp uñjañatakix yaqhipanak imaña jan ukax jaytaña ukat machaqtayaña.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Janiw sayt'at pirqa apaniwinak apaskaspati. Wasitat yant'añatakix machaqtayaña.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: Aka apaniwix janiw mä amtäw suyt'xiti.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Aka id ukani pirqax janiw aka apaniwimp luratäkiti, ukhamax janiw llamkt'atäkiti.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Scrum t'aqapax qillqasiskiwa jan ukax kutt'ayasiskiwa. Mä qawqha minutunakat wasitat yant'aña.
interrupted-import-failed: Aka lurawi janiw tukuyañjamäkiti. Laphi mayampi jist'aram ukat mayampi yant'am.
saml-login-not-started: Aka SAML ukamp mantañax janiw aka navegador pestañan qalltkänti. Mirä amp suma, mayampi mantam.
history-request-pending-undo: Luqtañ makina janiw qhipa kutt'ayawima chiqanchkiti.
history-request-pending-redo: Luqtañ makina janiw qhipa wasitat lurawima chiqanchkiti.
history-request-hint: Mayampi yant'asa, pachpa mayiwiw mayampi apayasi, ukatwa janipuni payïr mayjt'awi kutt'ayañjamäkiti.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Scrum mayjt'awinakan mä jan luratäkaspas ukham luraña, wasitat luraña jan ukax kutt'ayañax mä ch'axwawin sayt'i. Aka pirqan Scrum askichawinakax askichatäñkamaw jark'ata.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ / __total__ mayjt'awinakaw qillqata, __pending__ janiw qillqatäkiti, ukat __conflicted__ yaqhaniw jilat mayjt'ayi.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Qhiparu kutt'ayañax taqi mayjt'at qillqanak nayrjam kutt'ayi; jilat janiw khitis uka qillqanak mayjt'aykiti ukhakiw churasi. Pirqa kunjamäki ukham imañax sayt'at lurawi apaqi ukat janiw kuna qillqanakas mayjt'aykiti. Kunjamatsa, Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery ukanw qillqasi.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Taqi qillqanak jichhax kunjamäki ukham imañati, sayt'at lurawix niya qillqki uka mayjt'awinakamp chika?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Mä pirqa apnaqiriw qhiparu kutt'ayaspa jan ukax pirqa kunjamäki ukham imaspa.
login-setting-env-only: Servidor pachpa wakichäwikiw akanak uchi. Akanx liyiñatakikiw uñacht'ayatäski.
email-to-card-description: Pirqaman chiqaparu apayata aruskipäwix uka pirqan mä kartaruw tukuyi.
email-to-card-webhook: Aruskipäwi churirin mantani webhook URL (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark jan ukax MIME relay)
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Aka grain ukar aruskipäwix kawki pirqaruw saraski
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Janiw kunas - Asuntun pirqa token utjki uka aruskipäwinakak
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Aka pirqar juma pachpa purinañatakix asuntur aka uchtam:
email-to-card-address-private: Imantam: khitis utjki ukax jumjam kartanak yapxataspa.
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Aruskipäwi katuqañax janiw Apnaqirin pankapan wakicht'atäkiti.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Pirqa apnaqirix janiw aka pirqatak aruskipäwi jaqhantkiti.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain ukax janirakiw aruskipäwi chiqanïkiti. Laphi wasitat apkatam.
inbound-account-invalid: IMAP aruskipäwi q'ipix chiqap servidor sutiw munasi.
feature-views-email-desc: Pirqax mä qillqat jaqhukjamawa: aruskipäwi sutinakax Katuqatawa, sutinakax imañanakawa, unanchanakax unanchanakawa, masinakax pirqan utjäwipat aruskipäwinak qillqapxi ukat jaysapxi.
email-view-not-receiving: Aka pirqax janiw aruskipäwi katuqkiti. Pirqan Yatiyäwinak Wakicht'äwi → Aruskipäwi kartaru ukan qhanstayam.
email-view-invalid-address: Mä utjäwix janiw chiqa aruskipäwi utjäwïkiti.
email-view-too-many: Walja aruskipäwinakaw mä hora apayasi. Qhipat wasitat yant'am.
feature-views-chat-desc: Pirqax mä parlañ irnaqañ chiqawa: irnaqañ chiqanaka, pirqanaka, thakhinaka, sutinakaxa ukat kartanaka mä qhanalanak quqjama, kartax taypinkiwa ukat arxatanakapax parlañ yatiyäwinakjama.
chat-view-pick-card: Qhanalanakat mä karta ajllim akan uñjañataki.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Pachpa kartanaka walja sutini siqi tamanakan - tukuyatarjama, nayraqatarjama, chimpurjama jan ukax yaqharjama - siqinak taypin apsusa sarxi.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Tablero menú → Kamachinakaxa jaqinakan amparampi kuttʼayasiñap uñjasaw kamachinak iwxti.
feature-board-summary-desc: Tablero menú → Resumen ukax sapa jaqin qhipa urun jan ukax simanan luratapa uñacht'ayi, ukat tukuyañ uru pasatanaka.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Tablero menú → Qhipa visitamatxa yaqhanakax tableron kuns mayjt'ayapxi ukanak uñacht'ayi.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Taqpach thaqhañax "nayan tukuyañ urup pasat tarjetanakajaxa" ukham arunak amuyi.
column-sets-empty: Janïraw siqi tamanakax utjkiti. Pirqan apnaqañ irpiripax mä luraspawa: suti churma, ukat siqinak yapxatma.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Pirqa GitHub jan ukax Gitea jan walt'äwinak thaqhirjama: kartanak jan walt'äwinakjama, unanchanakampi chimpunakampi, arxatanakax aruskipäwjama, chikachatanakax qillqatanakjama, pirqan nayra sarawipampi kutt'ayañampi.
vcs-no-issues: Janiw kuna jan walt'äwis aka thaqhäwimp kikipkiti.
vcs-no-milestones: Janiw chimpunakax utjkiti. Tukuyaña uruni unanchax chimpuwa.
vcs-no-list: Aka pirqax janiw sutinakani ni thakhini jan walt'äwitakix.
card-qr-code-desc: Uñakipam aka karta jisk'a jawsañan jan ukax tabletan jist'arañataki.
card-qr-code-too-long: Aka kartan link ukax QR chimputakix wali jach'awa.
vcs-no-wiki: Janiw wikix utjkiti. GitHub tantachäwi mantayañaxa repositorio wiki aksaru apani.
github-org-import-desc: Sapa repositorio tantachäwinkiri jan ukax jaqinkirixa pachpa tablaruw tukuni, Board View / Version Control ukan jist'aratawa: jan walt'äwinakapa arxatanakapampi, unanchanakapampi, qillqatanakapampi, apsunakapa, GitHub Actions irnaqäwinakapa Kamachinakjama, wikipampi.
github-org-import-token-hint: Imata repositorionakataki, juk'amp API jaljawi munasi. Mantayañax sarkipana ukakiw apnaqasi, janipuniw imaskiti.
github-org-import-result: %s jan walt'äwi, %s apsu, %s kamachi, %s wiki laphi
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Tantachäwi jan ukax jaqi suti qillqma, jan ukax GitHub chiqapa.
optional-apis-desc: Yaqha tracker API ukanakar uñtasita REST API ukanaka, ukhamat apps ukat scripts ukanakapax aka WeKan backend ukham apnaqapxañapataki: imapki ukanakax WeKan ukan imasi, WeKan pirqanakan. Sapa mayniw jiwt'atäski aka chiqan chimpuntañkama. Janiw maynis pachpa derechonïkiti: mä cliente WeKan API token ukamp mantaski, ukat uka jaqix WeKan ukan uñjki ukat mayjt'ayki ukakiw uñjaspa ukat mayjt'ayaspa. Taqpachaniw WeKan REST API naktatäñap munapxi (WITH_API=true). Sapa maynin manqhapan utjki uka direccionaw mä cliente servidor ukham apnaqi.
optional-api-trello-desc: Trello REST API ukatak qillqat apps ukat scripts ukanaka (sañäni Trellinator) WeKan ukamp irnaqapxi: pirqanaka, sutinaka, kartanaka, unanchanaka, masinaka, arxatanaka ukat uñakipaña sutinaka. Trello token ukax mä WeKan API token ukawa. Mä karta chhaqtayañax WeKan ukan imañar apawa.
optional-api-jira-desc: Jira REST API v2 ukan clientenakapax WeKan ukamp irnaqapxi: mä proyectox mä pirqawa (llavepax pirqan llavepawa), mä jan walt'äwix mä kartawa (DEV-7), mä estadox mä sutinakawa, ukat mä transición ukax kartar unxtayi. Thaqhañax JQL simple ukak katuqi: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ukat ORDER BY. WeKan API token ukamp contraseña ukham mantam. Mä jan walt'äwi chhaqtayañax imañar apawa.
optional-api-github-desc: GitHub REST API jan walt'äwinakatak clientenakapax WeKan ukamp irnaqapxi: mä repositoriox mä pirqawa, mä jan walt'äwix mä kartawa, unanchanakampi, chimpunakampi (tukuyañ urunïki uka unanchanaka), arxatanakampi, ukat jist'arata jan ukax jist'antata pirqa uñjaña / Versión uñjaña ukan ukhama. Token ukax mä WeKan API token ukawa.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Gitea ukat Forgejo REST API jan walt'äwinakatak clientenakapax WeKan ukamp irnaqapxi, GitHub ukamp chikt'ata API ukham: mä repositoriox mä pirqawa ukat mä jan walt'äwix mä kartawa. Token ukax mä WeKan API token ukawa.
bots-none: Janiw kuna botas utjkiti. Bot ukax mä runneriwa juma servidoramana - mä AI agente, mä CI irnaqawi, mä script - aka pirqax kartanak churaraki.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Mistki webhooks ukanakax janiw WeKan pachpa red ukan direcciones ukanakar puriñapakiti, ukhamat janiw khitis mä pirqanakan webhook ukarux manqha servicio ukar uñachayañapakiti. Akan qillqt'am uka red ukan hosts ukanaka, kawkirinakarutix webhooks ukanakax puriñapa - mä Node-RED, mä chat servidor - sapa siqiru mayni, suti jan ukax direccionjama, mä puerto ukamp uka puerto ukak jaysañataki. Ch'usa: janiw kunas. Sitio apnaqañ irpirinakakiw aka siqi mayjt'ayapxaspa.
account-webhook-desc: Mä chiqa, kawkirirus WeKan yatiyi khitis mantkani jan ukax machaq cuenta lurasini ukhaxa. Janiw kunas apayatäkiti aka manqhan mä luräwi chimpuntañkama. Luräwi, apnaqirin sutipa ukat pacha apayi; yaqha chiqanak chimpuntam katuqirix munaspa ukhakiwa.
account-webhook-field-ip: Mantañax kawkit jutawayi uka IP chiqa
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Qawqha urut juk'amp nayra luräwinakan suyt'ir yatiyawinakap taqpach jaytañani?
vcs-synced-issue: Aka jan walt'äwix chikachatawa: arknaqiripan jist'arama, jist'antama.
sync-write-back: Mayjt'awinaka GitLab ukar kutt'ayaña: p'iqi suti, qhananchawi, arsutanaka, jist'antaña ukat wasitat jist'araña
email-bounces-description: Kuns WeKan lurixa kutt'anir aruskipäwimpixa: pantjata qillqata chiqa, phuqhata buzón, janiw oficinankiti sasin jaysäwi, spam kexa. Sapa kastax pachpa luräwinakaniwa, ukch'a kuti kutt'aniwayxi ukhaxa lurasi.
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Uka chiqax janiw utjkiti: pantja qillqata, chhaqtayata cuenta, jan uñt'at dominio.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Jichhax janiw puriykiti: buzón phuqhata, servidor irnaqaskiwa. Walja kuti arkt'asis ukakiw kunas sañ muni.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Janiw oficinankiti, samarañ pacha jan ukax ticket sistema jaysäwinaka. Aruskipäwix puriwayiwa.
email-bounces-ses-description: Amazon SES ukanxa, Bounce ukat Complaint yatiyäwinak apayam, ukat WeKan khaysat apayki uka chiqatak katuqañ kamachi, mä SNS yatichäwiru, ukat aka chiqa HTTPS tuqi qillqantam:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Katuqañatak SNS yatichäwi ARN, sapa siqiru maya
email-bounces-stopped-only: WeKan janiw juk'amp aruskipäwi apaykiti uka chiqanakakiwa
email-bounces-clear-hint: Aka chiqan kutt'äwinakap armaña ukat wasitat apayaña
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Ukax janiw SNS yatichäwi ARN ukäkiti.
email-bounces-providers-description: WeKan aka yanapt'awinakat maynimpi apayaspa ukhaxa, ch'amañchama, yanapt'awiru aka webhook chiqa churama kutt'anir aruskipäwinakataki ukhamarak spam kexanakataki, ukatxa aka chiqaru uchama kunampitix firmki uka llave, jan ukax chiqaru https://user:password@… jan ukax ?secret=… ukham uchkta uka imantata aru
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Ch'amañchat yanapt'awixa firmañ llavepa jan ukax imantata arupa munaraki.
activity-pub-enabled: Taqini uñjañ pirqanakax kartanakapan luräwinakap fediverse ukan uñstayapxi (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Qalltatpachax jiwt'ayatawa. Sartayatäkipanxa, sapa taqini uñjañ pirqax Mastodon ukatsa yaqha fediverse serviriranakatsa @board-<id> ukham aka WeKan chiqapan arkatäspawa, machaq karta luräwinakas arkirinakaparuw puri. Liyiñatakikiwa: kunatix fediverse serviriranakax apayki ukax janiw pirqa mayjt'aykiti, sapa jaqin pirqanakapas janipuniw uñstayatäkiti.
caldav-sync-desc: Aka pirqan kartanakapan tukuyaña urunakap mä pachachimpur uchaña - Nextcloud Calendar jan ukax kuna CalDAV pachachimpusa. Pachachimpun unxtayat tukuyaña urux kartaruw kutt'ani. Mä aplikasyun imantata aru apnaqam, janiw jumankirikiti.
caldav-invalid-url: Pachachimpun utt'awipax http:// jan ukax https:// utt'awiñapawa, janiw apnaqirin sutipas imantata arupas utjañapakiti.
caldav-not-linked: Nayraqatax mä pachachimpun utt'awip imam, ukat chikancht'aña sartayam.
webdav-storage-description: Chinutanak mä WebDAV serviriran q'ipiparu imam - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud jan ukax yaqhasa. WeKan ukatak lurat aplikasyun imantata aru apnaqam. Aka chiqanx WeKan pachpan red ukan serviriraparus apnaqasispawa, sitio apnaqirikiw aka utt'awi uchaspa.
sqrl-desc: Nayratpachaxa jist'antatawa. Jist'arataxa, mantañ laphixa SQRL uka churi, ukatxa sociosanakax nayraqatax SQRL uñt'ayasiñap Socio wakichawinakan yapapxi. SQRL ukax WeKan https:// jach'a utjañap munaraki.
sqrl-scan: Chimpu SQRL aplicacionamampi uñakipam, jan ukax aka aparatun SQRL clientem jist'aram.
sqrl-expired: Aka SQRL chimpux tukusxiwa. Wasitat qalltam.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL ukax WeKan https:// jach'a utjañap munaraki.
sqrl-description: SQRL uñt'ayasiñamampi manta, imantata arun lanti. Akan mä kutiki SQRL clientemampi yapam; kunapachas akat apaqasma.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: SQRL ukampi mantañax aka cuentataki SQRL clienteman jist'antatawa. Ukan wasitat jist'aram qhispiyañ chimpumampi.
sqrl-only-on: SQRL clientemax aka cuentaw SQRL ukaru llawintatayna: yaqha thakhinakampi mantañax janiw katuqatäkiti.
sqrl-hardlock-on: SQRL clientemax aka cuentaw ch'amampi llawintatayna: imantata aru machaqtayañasa, aruskipäwi mayjt'ayañasa janiw katuqatäkiti.
sqrl-hardlock: Aka cuentax SQRL ukaru llawintatawa: janiw yaqha thakhimpix kutt'ayañjamäkiti ni mayjt'ayañjamäkiti.
windows-sso-failed: Windows ukampi mantañax janiw walikiti. Windows jakhuwimaxa akan janiw iyawsatäkaspati.
